fields.label: Days before a lead with no follow up is untouched
fields.description: A lead in an Open stage with no open follow up is flagged untouched after this many days (SOS-P1-22).

fields.label: Default team for new leads
fields.description: A lead no assignment rule matches goes to this team's active agents in turn (SOS-P1-19).

fields.label: Consent enforcement
fields.description: Off by default. With it On, a call, an SMS or a WhatsApp message to a lead that is not Consented is refused and the refusal is logged. Only a Company Admin changes it, in the web app (SOS-P2-04).

fields.label: Partner lead limit
fields.description: The most leads one channel partner may register in an hour (SOS-P7-02).

fields.label: Partner protection days
fields.description: How long an approved partner registration is protected in the partner's name, counted from the approval (SOS-P7-02).

fields.label: Consent wording
fields.description: The words shown to a channel partner when they confirm that the buyer agreed to be contacted (SOS-P7-02), and to a person on the enquiry page (SOS-P2-08).

fields.label: Enquiry form key
fields.description: The key in the enquiry page link (SOS-P2-08). A Company Admin rotates it from the enquiry page settings.
